verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Flow as a first-class grant: the device passes its Client ID and the user authorizes on another device, so no long-lived secret is pasted. Auth0's own MCP server uses this same OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization to authenticate AI tools, which shows the flow applied to headless agent tooling. Missing for 10: device-flow docs that explicitly target CLIs and agents (they are framed around smart TVs and consoles), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
